description: This file defines a React component called 'ComparisonPanel' which provides a user interface for comparing and configuring different models or endpoints in a chat or AI application. It manages UI elements like selectors, settings, and advanced parameters, and handles interactions such as toggling synchronization, updating settings, and displaying messages.

methods.name: ComparisonPanel
methods.description: React functional component for rendering the comparison panel UI with settings and message display.

methods.name: handleSyncChange
methods.description: Handles toggling the synchronization of settings across models.

methods.name: handleAdvancedParamsChange
methods.description: Handles toggling the use of advanced parameters.

methods.name: handleSettingChange
methods.description: Generic handler for updating individual comparison settings.

methods.name: handleTogglePopover
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the settings popover.
